baseTemplate.title: Creative Marketing Co-op Student - NeoVibe Platform
baseTemplate.description:
Join TAURUS AI CORP's NeoVibe Creative Studio as a Co-op Student and immerse yourself in the world of AI-powered creative marketing, content generation, and multi-cultural marketing strategies. Work with our creative team to develop engaging campaigns and visual content that resonates with diverse audiences.

**About NeoVibe:**
NeoVibe is our creative marketing studio that combines AI technology with human creativity to produce compelling marketing content, visual assets, and multi-cultural campaigns. You'll work on projects that blend cutting-edge AI tools with traditional creative processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Assist in creating marketing content and visual assets
- Support social media campaign development and execution
- Contribute to content strategy and planning
- Help with brand consistency across platforms
- Participate in creative brainstorming sessions
- Assist in analyzing campaign performance metrics
- Support client collaboration and communication

**Learning Opportunities:**
- Master AI-powered content generation tools
- Learn multi-cultural marketing strategies
- Gain experience in social media marketing
- Understand brand development and management
- Experience creative project workflows
- Learn about marketing analytics and optimization

**Duration:** 4-8 months
**Start Date:** Flexible (typically January, May, or September)
**Location:** Remote/Hybrid options available
requirements: Currently enrolled in Marketing, Communications, Design, or related program
Strong creative and visual design skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced creative environment
preferredQualifications: Experience with design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva)
Basic understanding of AI/ML applications in marketing
benefits: Mentorship from creative directors and marketing experts
Access to premium creative tools and resources
Networking opportunities in the marketing industry
